resources.string: Saved sets and recorded answers work offline. AI is used only when you send selected text.
Open a course to choose sources, generate a draft and review it before saving.
Select 1–5 sources, at most 12,000 characters each and 36,000 in total. Only checked text is sent.
Use saved activity text, a verified downloaded document or your own excerpt. This screen does not fetch university documents.
Check every answer, explanation and quotation. Reference matching does not establish factual correctness. These are personal practice questions, not official exam questions.
Discard this draft and choose sources to generate another set.
Recall is your own report; no AI grading is performed.
This is personal practice progress, not an official mark or an estimate of mastery.
Current source version not checked; the saved source copy remains available.
Some current source text is unavailable. Practice uses the saved version.
Source text differs from the saved version. Inspect the saved evidence before using this set.
Matches the currently loaded source text; this is not a live university freshness check.
Some local practice data could not be read. It is retained; other accounts remain available.
Local data could not be loaded. Reload to retry; saved data is retained.
Check source selection, fields, distinct choices and supporting quotes. Your draft remains open.
AI did not return a verified practice set. Check the connection, quota and selected sources before retrying.
Changes were not saved. Retry explicitly; your draft or answer is retained. If data changed elsewhere, reload the library.
Cached source or saved practice data changed. Reload sources before generating; saved source copies remain available.
The owning account was removed. Its practice data is no longer shown.
Request canceled. If it reached the provider, processing or billing may already have occurred.
Cached source text could not be read. Retry local loading or add an excerpt.
1–12 questions; Mixed requires at least two.
Configure an AI connection before generating. Saved practice stays offline.
Only checked source text, topic, count and language are sent to the selected processor. University cookies, credentials and profiles are excluded.
The quote is checked against this source after whitespace normalization. Inspect whether it actually supports the answer.
Preview limited to the first 36,000 characters. Add a shorter excerpt before sending.
This clears only the unsaved draft. Saved sets and their progress remain intact.
This removes the saved questions, source copies and progress from this device. University records and files are unaffected.
